Package neqsim.process.dynamics

Class TransientStepIdentifier

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.dynamics.TransientStepIdentifier
public final class TransientStepIdentifier extends Object
Creates calculation identifiers with explicit transient physical-step semantics.

A non-null identifier passed to ProcessSystem.runTransient(dt, id) identifies one physical timestep. The same physical-step identifier may be reused for repeated algebraic/nonlinear evaluations inside that timestep so mutable clocks and controllers remain idempotent. The next physical timestep must use a different identifier.

Evaluation identifiers are separate diagnostic identities for nonlinear/refinement/substep work. They must not replace the physical-step identifier when invoking equipment or controllers whose idempotency is keyed to the physical step.

    • deterministicPhysicalStep

      public static UUID deterministicPhysicalStep(String scope, long physicalStepIndex)
      Creates a reproducible identifier for one physical timestep in a named run or scenario.

      This is useful for deterministic safety scenarios, regression tests and OTS replay. The same scope and step index always produce the same UUID, while adjacent physical steps produce different UUIDs.

      Parameters:
      scope - stable run, scenario or replay identity
      physicalStepIndex - zero-based physical-step index
      Returns:
      deterministic physical-step identifier

    • deterministicEvaluation

      public static UUID deterministicEvaluation(UUID physicalStepIdentifier, long evaluationIndex)
      Creates a reproducible diagnostic identity for one refinement/nonlinear evaluation within a physical timestep.

      This identity is for diagnostics, residual histories and solver bookkeeping. Continue passing the parent physicalStepIdentifier to equipment/controller runTransient calls so one physical step advances mutable state exactly once.

      Parameters:
      physicalStepIdentifier - parent physical-step identifier
      evaluationIndex - zero-based evaluation/refinement index
      Returns:
      deterministic evaluation identifier
